rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a stopwatch.

example.english: The coach used a stopwatch to record how long we took to run one lap.
example.traditional: 教練用秒錶記低我哋跑一圈用咗幾耐。
example.jyutping: gaau3 lin6 jung6 miu5 biu1 gei3 dai1 ngo5 dei6 paau2 jat1 hyun1 jung6 zo2 gei2 noi6

rows.note: Use this colloquial alternative for the same handheld time-measuring device.

example.english: When I run, I use a stopwatch myself to see whether this time is faster than last time.
example.traditional: 我跑步嗰陣會自己撳碼錶，睇吓今次快唔快過上次。
example.jyutping: ngo5 paau2 bou6 go2 zan6 wui5 zi6 gei2 gam6 maa5 biu1 tai2 haa5 gam1 ci3 faai3 m4 faai3 gwo3 soeng6 ci3
